# Commonwealth Financial Network

> > Independent broker-dealer and RIA providing technology, compliance, and practice management solutions for financial advisors across the United States.

Commonwealth Financial Network, headquartered in Waltham, MA with offices in San Diego, CA, is a FINRA/SIPC member firm supporting independent financial advisors with advanced planning resources, business development tools, and comprehensive compliance services. The firm specializes in helping advisors transition to fee-based models and grow their practices through M&A, succession planning, and innovative technology platforms.

## Key Topics

- Independent broker-dealer services
- Fee-based advisory models
- Practice management and growth
- Mergers and acquisitions (M&A)
- Succession planning
- Estate planning and tax strategies
- RIA compliance and regulatory support
- Advisor recruitment and transitions
- Wealth management technology
- Financial advisor training
- FINRA and SIPC membership
- Client asset management
- Cybersecurity for advisory firms
- Commonwealth Connect platform

## Advisor Solutions & Services

- [Advanced Planning & Research | Expertise and Insights for Complex Financial Issues](https://www.commonwealth.com/advisor-solutions/advanced-planning-and-research): Estate planning and research services for financial advisors
- [How to Choose the Best Firm Partner for Your Advisory Business](https://www.commonwealth.com/insights/how-to-choose-the-best-broker-dealer-for-you): Advisor guidance on selecting broker-dealer partnerships beyond sign-on bonuses
- [Overseeing Client Assets Held Away: Getting the Bigger Picture](https://www.commonwealth.com/insights/overseeing-client-assets-held-away-getting-the-bigger-picture): Managing held-away assets with technology solutions by Krista Teegarden
- [The Fee-Only Advisor](https://www.commonwealth.com/insights/the-fee-only-advisor/3): Fee-only advisor insights on model portfolios and investment management

## Practice Management & Growth

- [Marketing & Practice Management](https://www.commonwealth.com/insights/marketing-practice-management/14): Practice management and marketing strategies for advisory firms
- [Financing Options for the Next Phase of Your Financial Advisory Business](https://www.commonwealth.com/insights/financing-options-financial-advisory-business): Advisory business financing options including M&A and succession planning
- [Behind the Scenes: How These Advisor Brand Stories Came to Life](https://www.commonwealth.com/insights/how-these-advisor-brand-stories-came-to-life): Case study: Soar Wealth Strategies and advisor branding with Commonwealth
- [Developing Information Security Awareness at Your Advisory Firm](https://www.commonwealth.com/insights/8-tips-for-developing-a-security-awareness-program): Cybersecurity training tips for advisory firms on phishing and device security

## Tax & Financial Planning

- [Helping Your Clients Plan for the Sunset of the TCJA](https://www.commonwealth.com/insights/sunset-of-the-tcja): Tax planning guidance for TCJA sunset and estate tax exemption changes
- [Market & Economic Perspectives](https://www.commonwealth.com/insights/market-economic-perspectives/12): Market analysis on emerging markets, inflation, and crude oil by Brad McMillan
